description:
Compile and execute C# code on the Unity Editor main thread. The code may call UnityEngine, UnityEditor, project/package types, and Locus's typed Editor SDK. Private/internal access is enabled by default through `enable_non_public_access`.

Code without a top-level `await` runs synchronously. Code with a top-level `await` runs inside `ExecuteAsync(..., ExecuteCodeContext ctx, CancellationToken cancellationToken)` and can yield across Editor frames. Common System, Unity, UnityEditor, and Locus namespaces are pre-included; ambiguous short type names must be fully qualified.

Returning results:
- `print(obj)` appends plain text.
- `printJson(obj)` serializes stored structured data, including anonymous objects, public fields, auto-properties, dictionaries, and materialized collections. It never invokes target property getters. Shared and cyclic references use BFS-owned `$id`/`$ref` nodes; deferred/custom enumerables use descriptors without enumeration. Top-level Unity objects retain Editor serialization semantics; nested Unity object references use compact descriptors.
- `clear()` clears the result buffer.
- A single expression is printed automatically.

Context API:
- `ctx.GetConsoleLog(level, limit)` reads one optional Unity Console level. A string array uses OR semantics, for example `ctx.GetConsoleLog(new[] { "warn", "error" }, 50)`. Repeated entries are merged with a `count`.
- `ctx.PropertyTree(target, depth, maxArrayItems)` formats any `UnityEngine.Object` with the same live Property Tree used by `unity_yaml_read`. `depth` defaults to 2; Vector, Quaternion, Color, Rect, Bounds, curve, and gradient values stay inline without consuming another level. `LocusPropertyTree.Format(target, depth, maxArrayItems)` is the equivalent static SDK.
- `await ctx.wait`, `WaitFrame`, `WaitFrames`, `WaitSeconds`, and `WaitUntil` resume on later Editor updates.
- `ctx.Progress(title, info, progress)` reports progress to the Locus tool call panel. `ctx.ClearProgress`, `ctx.ThrowIfCancellationRequested`, and `ctx.CancellationToken` support cleanup and cancellation.
- With `com.unity.test-framework`, use `await UnityTestApi.ListAsync(query)` for discovery and `UnityTestApi.Start(options)`, `Status(runId)`, and `Cancel(runId)` for persisted test runs.

`request_editor_status` declares the required state before execution. If the code explicitly changes status through EditorApplication play/pause APIs, Locus applies the same Unity status-change permission. Bare `return;` does not compile; use `return null;`. Do not trigger script recompilation or import/modify `.cs` files during execution because the plugin connection is lost during domain reload.

Examples:
```
var go = GameObject.Find("Player");
print(ctx.PropertyTree(go, depth: 2, maxArrayItems: 4));
```
```
printJson(ctx.GetConsoleLog(new[] { "warn", "error" }, 50));
```
```
var tests = await UnityTestApi.ListAsync(new UnityTestQuery { Mode = UnityTestMode.Edit });
printJson(tests);
```

code.description: C# code to compile and execute in Unity Editor. Written as the body of a static method. Use print(obj), printJson(obj), or ctx.PropertyTree(target, depth, maxArrayItems) to return results.

readonly.description: Whether the code only observes state. Use true only when it does not change Unity objects, assets, scenes, project settings, editor state, project files, or other filesystem content. Read-only calls are scheduled with read tools and skip workspace mutation locking and undo snapshots.

request_editor_status.description: Required Unity Editor status before running. If the current status must change, or the code explicitly changes status through EditorApplication play/pause APIs, Locus applies the Unity status-change permission before continuing.

enable_non_public_access.description: Allow this call to directly access private and internal types, APIs, and fields without reflection. Defaults to true and is also governed by the global Hot Reload & Compile setting.
